events.description: Scoped as audit-only: implementation stage writes findings into task.md and spins out child tasks per finding, mirroring task-codebase-audit-064. No production code or Design-doc edits land under 082.

Four phases, one per review axis (Architecture & ECS hygiene, Code-vs-Design drift, Correctness & bug surface, Performance hot spots). Each phase's Files section lists directories/docs it audits, not files it edits.

Acceptance gates require file:line anchors + triage column on every row, save/load component coverage enumerated against Core/Components/, performance rows measured-or-tagged (no hand-waving), and explicit cross-reference against task-065 (Age 0) and the 13 open Age 1 / sect / drift tasks so 082 does not duplicate their backlog.

Report schema fixed: task-064 baseline table (Surface|Item|Issue|File:line|Triage) extended per section — §B adds Doc-ref + Cross-ref task; §C adds Severity (crash/wrong-result/degraded/edge-only); §D adds Measured? (concrete cost or needs-measurement). Triage vocabulary locked to drop/wire/fix/park/spin-out. Each section ends with a four-bucket Triage summary (Drop now / Wire or decide / Fix soon / Park). Child task stubs link back to parent row, inherit file:line anchor, carry type: bug|improvement|task, and start in scope stage so the human confirms before work begins. Anchors are VS Code clickable relative links; TechTree.json uses key-path link text with no line.

Technical approach fixed: four phases run data-first then orchestration (components → commands → systems → seam → AI), Grep recipes locked per phase (SystemBase/ISystem enumeration, EntityManager.GetComponent guard check, IComponentData enumeration for save/load coverage, LINQ/allocation patterns for perf), Phase 1 component list is reused by Phase 3 save/load row, Phase 4 runs last because measurement is most expensive, all needs-measurement rows roll into one perf-measurement child task instead of one task per row, no production code or Design-doc edits land under 082.

events.summary: All nine acceptance criteria pass. Sections A/B/C/D populated (A=19, B=76 actual table rows across six subsections though phase-4 note recorded 53, C=24 findings + 22-file save/load enumeration, D=18). Every row carries Assets/Scripts/.../File.cs#LNNN or docs/Design/<doc>.md or TechTree.json anchor + drop/wire/fix/park/spin-out triage column. Every Age-0 §B row cross-references task-065. §C.3 enumerates all 23 component files / 247 declarations by name + file and tags each MISSING pending task-081. §D rows are either needs-measurement-tagged or n/a-static-analysis with concrete static cost (e.g. 72k GetComponent/sec, 24k MaterialPropertyBlock/sec). Each section ends with a Drop/Wire/Fix/Park triage summary. All 25 child stubs (083-107) exist with task.md + state.json — manually-created C-section stubs (096-102) are well-formed and not corrupted; no duplicate IDs. Git diff confined to .deft/tasks/ — no Assets/Scripts, docs/Design, HudFrontend, or ProjectSettings changes (the EditorBuildSettings.asset mod predates this task). Minor notes (non-blocking): (a) §B subsection row count (76) exceeds the phase-2 completion note (53) — the audit went deeper than reported in state.json; (b) child task source: field varies across spin-out / task-profound-code-review-082 / parent-task-082 — SCHEMA itself only formally allows manual/imported/roadmap, so this is project-wide convention drift, not a task-082 regression; (c) stub_created vs task_created event-type split between manual C-stubs and D-stubs — both convey the same intent.

Audit task complete. §A=19 rows, §B=76 rows across six subsections, §C=24 findings + 247-component save/load enumeration across 23 files, §D=18 rows. 25 child tasks spun out (083-107) covering architecture, design drift, correctness, and performance follow-ups. Audit Summary section appended to task.md. No production code changes — audit-only task per scope decision.
